original_agent_description: Node-agnostic stimulus generator. Produces directed and constrained-random stimulus targeted at coverage goals and corner cases from the shared verification plan (vplan). Generation is SEEDED PSEUDO-RANDOM SAMPLING over ranges and weighted value-sets, with simple relational blocks honoured by bounded rejection sampling -- there is NO SMT/CSP solver. Every transaction is re-checked against the full constraint set (field domains and relational blocks) immediately before emission; a sample that does not conform is DROPPED rather than emitted, and the resulting shortfall gates the run. Satisfiability is witness-based: conforming samples prove the constraint set satisfiable, while exhausting the try budget is reported as UNKNOWN, never as proof of contradiction.
